IELC.description: Ignore Element for Load Cases (IELC). Each entry pairs an existing element with a static load case name and flags whether that element is ignored for that load case; the union of element and load case identifies the record.

ELEMENT.description: Element key (number) of an existing element to ignore for the given load case. Must reference an element that exists in the model.

LCNAME.description: Name of an existing static load case (D_LCOM_STATIC) for which the element is ignored. Must match a defined static load case name.

OPT_IGNORE.description: Ignore option (true/false): true ignores the element for the load case, false includes it.
